20260411_0001_key: What is the most widely used currency in the world?
20260411_0001_answer: The US dollar is used in about 88% of all foreign exchange transactions worldwide, and many countries adopt it as their reserve currency!
20260411_0002_key: Approximately how many bones does an adult human have?
20260411_0002_answer: An adult has about 206 bones. Babies are born with around 270, but some bones fuse together as they grow!
20260411_0003_key: In which ancient Greek city did democracy first originate?
20260411_0003_answer: Athens became the world's first direct democracy around the 5th century BC. Citizens voted directly to create laws!
20260411_0004_key: Which country has the largest population in the world?
20260411_0004_answer: India surpassed China in 2023 to become the world's most populous country, with approximately 1.44 billion people!

20260411_0005_answer: South Korea uses a three-tier court system, with the Supreme Court serving as the final appellate court that makes the ultimate legal decisions!
20260411_0006_key: What does a 'Bear Market' mean in the stock market?
20260411_0006_answer: A bear market refers to a decline of 20% or more in stock prices. The term comes from the image of a bear swiping its paws downward!
20260411_0006_opt2: A market decline of 20% or more
20260411_0006_opt3: A market with very low trading volume
20260411_0006_opt4: A market with many new IPOs

20260411_0007_answer: During an earthquake, getting under a sturdy table to protect your head is the top priority. Wait until the shaking stops before evacuating!
20260411_0007_opt2: Open a window and look outside
20260411_0007_opt3: Get under a table and protect your head
20260411_0007_opt4: Run outside the building right away
20260411_0008_key: What is effective for removing odors from a refrigerator?
20260411_0008_answer: Baking soda absorbs odors naturally, making it a highly effective deodorizer when placed inside the fridge!
20260411_0009_key: What is the primary function of RAM (Random Access Memory)?
20260411_0009_answer: RAM temporarily stores data for programs currently in use. It's volatile memory, meaning everything is erased when the power is turned off!
20260411_0010_key: Who is the author of the Harry Potter series?
20260411_0010_answer: J.K. Rowling wrote Harry Potter in a cafe, and the series has sold over 500 million copies worldwide, making it one of the best-selling book series ever!
20260411_0011_key: How many hours of sleep per night are recommended for adults?
20260411_0011_answer: According to the National Sleep Foundation, adults should get 7 to 9 hours of sleep per night. Adequate sleep is crucial for immunity and focus!
20260411_0012_key: Why do we yawn when we see someone else yawning?
20260411_0012_answer: Mirror neurons are brain cells that activate when we observe someone else's actions. They help us empathize and mimic behaviors!
20260411_0013_key: Approximately what percentage of Earth's surface is covered by water?
20260411_0013_answer: About 71% of Earth's surface is covered by water. However, 97% of it is saltwater, so the amount of drinkable freshwater is very small!
20260411_0014_key: What does the Turing Test evaluate?
20260411_0014_answer: The Turing Test, proposed by Alan Turing in 1950, evaluates whether a machine can converse in a way that is indistinguishable from a human!
20260411_0014_opt2: Whether a machine can think like a human
20260411_0015_key: What is the main reason for adding salt when boiling pasta?
20260411_0015_answer: Salt seasons the pasta as it cooks, enhancing its flavor. While it slightly raises the boiling point, the main purpose is to add taste!
20260411_0015_opt2: To make the water boil faster
20260411_0016_key: How often is the FIFA World Cup held?
20260411_0016_answer: The FIFA World Cup is held every 4 years, alternating with the Olympics at 2-year intervals. The first tournament was held in Uruguay in 1930!
20260411_0017_key: What type of celestial body is the Sun?
20260411_0017_answer: The Sun is a star that produces light and heat through hydrogen fusion. It's also the closest star to Earth!
20260411_0018_key: What is the main reason cats purr?
20260411_0018_answer: A cat's purr mainly expresses contentment and comfort. Sometimes they also purr for self-healing or stress relief!
20260411_0019_key: How many strings does a violin have?
20260411_0019_answer: A violin has four strings: G, D, A, and E. The E string produces the highest pitch!
20260411_0020_key: What is the most spoken language in the world by native speakers?
20260411_0020_answer: Mandarin Chinese is spoken by over 900 million native speakers, making it number one. English actually ranks around third by native speakers!
20260411_0021_key: What longitude serves as the basis for Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)?
20260411_0021_answer: The 0-degree longitude passes through the Royal Observatory in Greenwich, England, known as the Prime Meridian. Time zones are divided east and west from this line!
20260411_0022_key: What element does the symbol 'Fe' represent on the periodic table?
20260411_0022_answer: Fe stands for Iron. The symbol comes from the Latin word 'Ferrum,' and iron has the atomic number 26!
20260411_0023_key: In what year was the Roman Empire split into East and West?
20260411_0023_answer: After the death of Theodosius I in 395 AD, the Roman Empire was divided into the Eastern and Western Roman Empires. The Western Roman Empire fell in 476 AD!
20260411_0024_key: What is the longest mountain range in the world?
20260411_0024_answer: The Andes stretches about 7,000 km along the western coast of South America, making it the world's longest mountain range!
20260411_0025_key: What does the 'Double Jeopardy' principle mean?
20260411_0025_answer: Double jeopardy is the right not to be tried or punished twice for the same offense. It's a fundamental legal protection found in many constitutions!
20260411_0025_opt1: Not being punished twice for the same crime

20260411_0026_opt2: The conversion ratio between different currencies
20260411_0027_key: What is the correct first aid for a bee sting?
20260411_0027_answer: A bee stinger should be scraped off with a flat object like a credit card. Using tweezers can squeeze the venom sac and inject more venom!
20260411_0027_opt1: Pull out the stinger with tweezers
20260411_0027_opt2: Suck the venom out by mouth
20260411_0027_opt3: Scrape out the stinger with a flat object
20260411_0028_key: What is the most effective way to remove grease stains from clothing?
20260411_0028_answer: Dish soap contains surfactants that break down grease, making it highly effective at removing oil stains from fabric!
20260411_0028_opt1: Just pour hot water on it
20260411_0029_key: What is an API (Application Programming Interface)?
20260411_0029_answer: An API is a set of rules that allows different software systems to communicate and exchange data. It acts as a bridge between apps and servers!
20260411_0029_opt1: A set of communication rules between software
20260411_0030_key: What was the first movie in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU)?
20260411_0030_answer: Iron Man, released in 2008, launched the MCU. Robert Downey Jr.'s portrayal of Tony Stark became hugely popular!
20260411_0031_key: Which food is rich in omega-3 fatty acids?
20260411_0031_answer: Salmon is packed with omega-3 fatty acids EPA and DHA, which support cardiovascular health and brain function!
20260411_0032_key: 'Dunbar's Number' refers to the number of stable relationships a person can maintain. What is it approximately?
20260411_0032_answer: British anthropologist Robin Dunbar proposed that humans can maintain about 150 stable social relationships!
20260411_0033_key: What happens to sea levels when Arctic ice melts?
20260411_0033_answer: Arctic sea ice is already floating in the ocean, so melting it doesn't significantly change sea levels. However, melting Greenland's ice sheet would cause a major rise!
20260411_0033_opt1: Little change (it's already floating in water)
20260411_0034_key: What does IoT (Internet of Things) mean?
20260411_0034_answer: IoT is the technology that connects everyday devices like refrigerators, air conditioners, and light bulbs to the internet to share data!
20260411_0034_opt2: Everyday devices connected to the internet
20260411_0035_key: What is the key ingredient that makes bread dough rise?
20260411_0035_answer: Yeast feeds on sugar and releases carbon dioxide gas, which causes the dough to rise. That's the secret behind bread's fluffy texture!
20260411_0036_key: What happens when a batter gets three strikes in baseball?
20260411_0036_answer: Three strikes means a strikeout! The batter is out, and it's one of the most fundamental rules in baseball.
20260411_0037_key: How long does the International Space Station (ISS) take to orbit Earth once?
20260411_0037_answer: The ISS travels at about 27,600 km/h and orbits Earth roughly every 90 minutes. That means astronauts see about 16 sunrises a day!
20260411_0038_answer: Dolphins use 'unihemispheric sleep,' resting one half of their brain at a time. They keep one eye open to stay alert for danger!
20260411_0038_opt1: They sink to the bottom and sleep
20260411_0038_opt2: They rest one half of their brain at a time
20260411_0039_key: In which country did the Impressionist art movement originate?
20260411_0039_answer: Impressionism began in France in the 1860s. Artists like Monet, Renoir, and Degas focused on capturing fleeting impressions of light and color!
20260411_0040_answer: Onomatopoeia refers to words that imitate sounds, like 'buzz,' 'click,' and 'boom.' Every language has its own unique set of sound words!
20260411_0040_opt2: Translating foreign words into native language
20260411_0041_key: Are Olympic gold medals actually made of pure gold?
20260411_0041_answer: Modern Olympic gold medals are actually silver coated with gold plating. The last time solid gold medals were awarded was at the 1912 Stockholm Olympics!
20260411_0042_key: Can sound travel through a vacuum?
20260411_0042_answer: Sound is a wave that travels through a medium like air or water. In a vacuum, there's no medium, so sound cannot travel!
20260411_0042_opt4: It converts to light and travels
20260411_0043_key: Which Chinese emperor first began construction of the Great Wall?
20260411_0043_answer: Qin Shi Huang, after unifying China in 221 BC, began building the Great Wall to defend against northern nomadic invasions!
20260411_0044_key: Approximately how many countries are on the African continent?
20260411_0044_answer: Africa has 54 independent nations, making it the continent with the most countries in the world!
20260411_0045_key: What is the minimum age to obtain a driver's license in South Korea?
20260411_0045_answer: In South Korea, you can obtain a Class 1 or Class 2 driver's license starting at age 18!

20260411_0047_answer: 119 connects you to both the fire department and emergency medical services in South Korea. You can report fires, rescues, and medical emergencies all through 119!

20260411_0048_answer: Turn it off, wipe away the moisture, and let it air dry naturally. Experts actually don't recommend the rice method!

20260411_0048_opt2: Keep trying to turn it on

20260411_0050_answer: Mario is a plumber! When he first appeared in the 1981 game 'Donkey Kong,' he was called 'Jumpman.'
20260411_0051_key: Which macronutrient provides the most calories per gram: carbohydrates, protein, or fat?
20260411_0051_answer: Fat provides about 9 kcal per gram, more than double that of carbohydrates (4 kcal) or protein (4 kcal)!
20260411_0052_key: What psychological phenomenon does the 'Diderot Effect' describe?
20260411_0052_answer: The Diderot Effect is the tendency to buy more things that match a new purchase. It's named after the French philosopher Diderot, who experienced this firsthand!
20260411_0052_opt1: Perceiving expensive items as better quality
20260411_0052_opt2: Being unable to decide when given too many choices
20260411_0052_opt3: Making additional purchases to match a new item
20260411_0053_key: What produces the most oxygen on Earth?
20260411_0053_answer: Ocean phytoplankton produces 50-80% of Earth's oxygen, far more than the Amazon rainforest!

20260411_0055_key: Why does wasabi's spiciness fade so quickly?
20260411_0055_answer: The spicy compound in wasabi, allyl isothiocyanate, is highly volatile and evaporates rapidly. That's why the sharp nose-tingling sensation disappears so fast!
20260411_0055_opt2: The spicy compound is highly volatile
20260411_0055_opt4: It breaks down when exposed to oxygen
20260411_0056_key: What is the official distance of a marathon?
20260411_0056_answer: A marathon is 42.195 km (26.2 miles). This distance was finalized at the 1908 London Olympics to match the route to the royal balcony!
20260411_0057_key: What is the closest planet to Earth?
20260411_0057_answer: Venus is the closest planet to Earth at about 40 million km away. It shines brightly at dawn and dusk, earning it the nickname 'Morning Star'!
20260411_0058_key: What is the longest-lived animal on Earth?
20260411_0058_answer: The Greenland shark is estimated to live up to 500 years! It takes about 150 years just to reach sexual maturity.
20260411_0059_key: Which country first developed the 'Do Re Mi' musical scale system?
20260411_0059_answer: In the 11th century, Italian monk Guido d'Arezzo created the 'Do Re Mi' system by using the first syllables of a hymn's lyrics!
20260411_0060_key: What sense does Braille rely on?
20260411_0060_answer: Braille is a tactile writing system where raised dots are read by touch. It was invented by Louis Braille of France in 1824!
20260411_0061_key: What did Alfred Nobel, who established the Nobel Prize, invent?
20260411_0061_answer: Alfred Nobel invented dynamite by stabilizing nitroglycerin. He used his fortune to establish the Nobel Prize fund!
20260411_0062_key: What gas is essential for photosynthesis in plants?
20260411_0062_answer: Plants use carbon dioxide, water, and sunlight to produce glucose and oxygen. Most of the oxygen we breathe comes from photosynthesis!
20260411_0063_key: In what year did Columbus reach the Americas?
20260411_0063_answer: Christopher Columbus, sponsored by the Spanish queen, sailed across the Atlantic and reached the Caribbean islands in 1492!
20260411_0064_key: What is the national flower of South Korea?
20260411_0064_answer: The Mugunghwa (Rose of Sharon) is South Korea's national flower, meaning 'the flower that blooms endlessly.' It blooms for over 100 days from summer to fall!

20260411_0066_opt4: Keep a record of what you ate

20260411_0067_answer: Submerging the lid in hot water causes the metal to expand, making it easier to twist off. Wearing rubber gloves for grip also works well!

20260411_0069_answer: Kim Eun-sook is one of South Korea's most acclaimed drama writers, known for hits like 'Descendants of the Sun' and 'Goblin'!

20260411_0072_answer: Number 1 stands for PET (Polyethylene Terephthalate), commonly used for water and beverage bottles. It has one of the highest recycling rates!
20260411_0073_key: What is the basic unit of information in a quantum computer?
20260411_0073_answer: A qubit (quantum bit) can represent 0 and 1 simultaneously, unlike classical bits. It's the quantum computing equivalent of a traditional bit!
20260411_0074_key: What is the main ingredient of tofu?
20260411_0074_answer: Tofu is made by adding a coagulant to soy milk extracted from soybeans. It's a high-protein, low-calorie food enjoyed worldwide!
20260411_0075_key: In golf, what is it called when you score one stroke under par?
20260411_0075_answer: A birdie is one stroke under par for a hole. Two under is an eagle, and three under is the rare albatross!
20260411_0076_key: What is Saturn's most distinctive feature?
20260411_0076_answer: Saturn's rings are made of ice and rock fragments, spanning about 280,000 km wide. But surprisingly, they're only about 10 to 100 meters thick!
20260411_0077_answer: Penguins' wings have evolved into flippers, so they cannot fly. However, they're expert swimmers, reaching speeds up to 36 km/h in the water!
20260411_0077_opt4: They can fly only when young
20260411_0078_key: Which Baroque-era composer is famous for 'The Four Seasons'?
20260411_0078_answer: Vivaldi's 'The Four Seasons' is a set of violin concertos depicting spring, summer, autumn, and winter through music. It's one of the most popular entry points to classical music!
20260411_0079_key: Does sign language differ from country to country?
20260411_0079_answer: Yes! Each country has its own unique sign language system. Korean Sign Language, American Sign Language (ASL), and British Sign Language (BSL) are all completely different languages!
20260411_0079_opt4: English-speaking countries share the same one
20260411_0080_key: What is the most consumed beverage in the world (besides water)?
20260411_0080_answer: Tea is the world's most consumed beverage after water. It's believed to have been first discovered in China around 2737 BC!
20260411_0081_key: What type of strong acid is found in the human stomach?
20260411_0081_answer: The stomach secretes hydrochloric acid (HCl) with a pH of 1-2, which digests food and kills bacteria. The stomach lining is protected by a mucus layer!
20260411_0082_key: In which country did the Industrial Revolution first begin?
20260411_0082_answer: The Industrial Revolution began in Britain in the late 18th century with inventions like the steam engine and spinning machines. It then spread across the world!
20260411_0083_key: Where is the best place to see the Aurora (Northern Lights)?
20260411_0083_answer: Auroras occur where Earth's magnetic field interacts with solar wind, making polar regions ideal. Norway, Iceland, and northern Canada are popular viewing spots!
20260411_0084_key: What matter requires a national referendum in South Korea?
20260411_0084_answer: Constitutional amendments must pass through the National Assembly and then be approved by a national referendum. It requires a majority of voters participating and a majority of those voting yes!
20260411_0085_key: What is the difference between a 'time deposit' and a 'savings plan'?
20260411_0085_answer: A time deposit involves depositing a lump sum and earning interest, while a savings plan involves making regular monthly contributions to build up savings!

20260411_0086_key: What is the correct first aid for someone with heatstroke?
20260411_0086_answer: Heatstroke is a medical emergency where body temperature rises above 40C (104F). Move the person to a cool area and lower their body temperature quickly!
20260411_0086_opt2: Move them to a cool area and lower their body temperature
20260411_0087_key: What is a simple way to check if an egg is fresh?
20260411_0087_answer: A fresh egg sinks in water, while an old egg floats because the air pocket inside grows larger over time!
20260411_0087_opt3: Put it in water (it sinks if fresh)

20260411_0088_answer: The goalkeeper can handle the ball with their hands, but only inside their own penalty area. Using hands outside the box is a foul!
20260411_0088_opt1: Handle the ball anywhere on the field
20260411_0088_opt4: Handle the ball inside the penalty area
20260411_0089_key: What is the most abundant element in the universe?
20260411_0089_answer: Hydrogen makes up about 75% of all matter in the universe. It's the fuel for stellar fusion and was the first element formed after the Big Bang!
20260411_0090_key: How many times its own body weight can an ant carry?
20260411_0090_answer: Ants can carry about 50 times their own body weight! This is because they have an extremely high muscle-to-body ratio for their size.

20260411_0093_key: What do we call a year that has 366 days instead of 365?
20260411_0093_answer: A leap year adds one extra day to February every four years, making it 366 days. This corrects for the fact that Earth's orbit takes slightly longer than 365 days!
20260411_0094_key: What do diamonds and pencil lead (graphite) have in common?
20260411_0094_answer: Both diamonds and graphite are made entirely of carbon atoms! The difference in their properties comes from how those carbon atoms are bonded together.
20260411_0095_key: What is the deepest lake in the world?
20260411_0095_answer: Lake Baikal in Russia reaches a maximum depth of 1,642 meters, making it the deepest lake on Earth. It holds about 20% of the world's freshwater!
20260411_0096_key: What does the gut microbiome primarily affect?
20260411_0096_answer: Gut microorganisms influence immunity, digestion, mental health, and more. The gut is often called the 'second brain' because of its significance!
20260411_0097_key: What is a 'Dark Pattern' in design?
20260411_0097_answer: A dark pattern is a deceptive UI design trick that manipulates users into unintended actions. A common example is making subscription cancellation deliberately difficult!
20260411_0097_opt4: A method for accessing the dark web
20260411_0098_key: What is the main compound responsible for the savory taste (umami) in soy sauce?
20260411_0098_answer: Glutamic acid is a key umami (savory taste) compound found in soy sauce, cheese, and tomatoes. It's also the basis for MSG!

20260411_0099_opt3: Judgments being fixed by the first information received

20260411_0100_key: What is the name of the conversational AI service developed by OpenAI?
20260411_0100_answer: ChatGPT was launched in November 2022 and reached 100 million users within just two months, sparking the global AI boom!
